verdict: Organic engagement is active but decelerating; paid channels remain offline.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, your Google Business Profiles were the sole source of measurable engagement, combining for 396 total actions — calls, direction requests, and web clicks — with zero paid spend on Meta or Google Ads. GBP engagement fell sharply in the last seven days, dropping roughly 60% at Forte Precision Metals and 53% at Advance Grinding Services, while O'Hare held nearly flat; this deceleration is confirmed, not noise. A meaningful number of project milestones spanning CRM setup, site reindexing, outreach, and content have passed their due dates and are being addressed now as the immediate priority. Search interest at Advance Grinding and O'Hare is holding or rising — organic intent is there — but without paid campaigns and a complete CRM pipeline, that intent is not being captured at the rate it should be. Once the overdue milestones are cleared, paid activation and outreach sequences can move forward and you should see measurable lead volume appear.

watch_item.fix: Listing phone numbers and call-tracking setup are being reviewed now, and site reindexing is in motion to restore local search visibility.
